label: RIP
notes: RIP v1/v2 over UDP port 520. Only the fixed 4-byte header is modelled: Command, Version and the must-be-zero word. Route entries are variable-count 20-byte chains, and the first entry of a RIPv2 packet may be an authentication record (RFC 2453 section 4.1) instead of a route, so no byte past the header sits at a trustworthy fixed offset. RIPv1 and RIPv2 share this header; the entry semantics behind it differ.

fields.label: Must be Zero
fields.description: Unused; senders set it to zero, receivers must not rely on it.
